scopedCoverageNotes.text: All23 local candidate fields31 printed names in current official native4-page Pierce composite are complete, with5 shared held Supreme Court fields10 names also refreshed. Every one of those28 full fields41 names/parties/terms matches current native state filing list election899 county27 (all80 source rows Active). All printed single-candidate fields remain ordinary candidates, never inferred declared elected.

Six Southeast Electoral District fields/seven names exactly reuse the King prepared contest and candidacy IDs. Pierce native sample, current state list and county pamphlet agree; pamphlet pages28–31 explicitly identify these as King County District Court judges. Exact full official Southeast geometry is reused without clipping to county boundaries. Applicable Pierce areas do not authorize a whole-Pierce membership.

Court of Appeals DivisionII District1 Position2 has one printed candidate, Meng Li Che. RCW2.06.020(2)(a) explicitly makes this district Pierce County; its electorate is the exact county division. Pierce County District Court positions1–8 remain county offices, distinct from named Southeast Electoral District and Tacoma Municipal Court. Council districts1/5/7 keep exact district OCD IDs pending reader joins.

Candidate-only packet. The complete sample also contains7 Pierce charter amendments and7 other local measures (plus3 held statewide initiatives); raw source text and a separate inventory are preserved, without adding optional measures or changing held legislative/measures data.

No current separate qualified-write-in supplement was acquired. State filing source has Active rows but no separate write-in qualification certification, so absence is not asserted. Generic blank optional write-in spaces identify no people. No cancelled/declared-elected office or withdrawn identity is inferred from one-name fields or missing supplementary records.

All current sources are original native PDF/HTML bytes with exact hashes/extraction; no voter identity or personal-address lookup was used. Shared King geometry and identities remain data prepared for River; reader application joins and source-based qualified-write-in updates remain explicit. No git or production operation.
